PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStro:
Even if a POKéMON is weak now, it will grow stronger.
The most important thing is love! Love for your POKéMON!
PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful: Do you use REPEL? It keeps POKéMON away, so it's useful when you're in a hurry.
PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidote:
Do you have any ANTIDOTES with you?
If you walk around with a poisoned POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints. Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
